one_liner: Mailchimp Marketing API v3 is a broad REST API with self-serve API keys and OAuth 2. The vendor publishes an official MCP for the Transactional API and a docs-search MCP, but none that acts on a Marketing account (only community servers do).
auth_notes: The vendor's Authentication page is said to cover API key and OAuth 2 credentials for the Marketing API. The supplied pages don't detail Basic or Bearer use, token lifetime or app registration. Basic and Bearer come from the draft, which cited a page not supplied here. The Transactional MCP uses a separate Transactional API key.
access_notes: Community READMEs show an account plus an API key is enough, and a vendor-facing README notes that template reads work on free plans, so a free plan exists. Some write features need a paid plan. The supplied pages don't spell out free-tier key creation, so this is inferred.
blocker_notes: No gate on getting an API key appears in the pages. Plan level affects some features. The official MCP covers only Transactional (Mandrill) and the docs site; Marketing account actions are covered only by community MCP servers (cyanheads, alexlaguardia). The draft's damientilman repo is not supported by the pages.
